subject: general
question: D, E, F, G, O, P and Q are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of E. Only O sits to the right of G. Only three people sit between G and F. Q sits at some place to the left of P but at some place to the right of D. How many people sit between D and P?
solution:
Given:

 

1. There are 7 people. Only three people sit to the left of E. 

2. Only O sits to the right of G. 

3. Only three people sit between G and F.

4. Q sits left of P but right of D (D [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aebeed70e92d838770f96913cb60e9261bce4468d34e1307c0cc93074dd8993.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa5f7b9d5cc67f31a1a3d734c7c2dd743789cf22e95d68b90fe84e7eca6a4f2f.png] 

 

Thus, there are three people (F, Q, E) sitting between D and P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
